title: Run the hash-bound BMO agent benchmark
description: Orchestrate, resume, score, browser-review, and package BMO16 v3: eight Flash initial builds and matched Flash/Pro repairs of four frozen artifacts across Hermes and ClaudeSeek.
prerequisites: plan receipt reports 8 prepared initial targets, 8 pending repair targets and 8 initial prompts
owner explicitly approves the displayed plan scope and hard stop; the conductor retains the exact unexpired SHA-256 and token

commands: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File '<AI_WIKI_ROOT>\04_skills\agent-skills\skills\bmo-agent-benchmark\scripts\Invoke-BmoAgentBenchmarkV3.ps1' -Action Plan -WorkspaceRoot '<fresh DEV_ROOT machine-local run root>' -Json

pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File '<AI_WIKI_ROOT>\04_skills\agent-skills\skills\bmo-agent-benchmark\scripts\Invoke-BmoAgentBenchmarkV3.ps1' -Action Run -WorkspaceRoot '<same run root>' -ApprovedPlanSha256 '<conductor-retained SHA-256>' -ConfirmToken '<conductor-retained token>' -Resume -Json

pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File '<AI_WIKI_ROOT>\04_skills\agent-skills\skills\bmo-agent-benchmark\scripts\Invoke-BmoAgentBenchmarkV3.ps1' -Action Run -WorkspaceRoot '<same run root>' -ApprovedPlanSha256 '<conductor-retained SHA-256>' -ConfirmToken '<conductor-retained token>' -Resume -ContinueAfterFailedCell -Json
execution.write_policy: The read-only MCP exposes guidance only. Paid Run still requires exact plan-hash and token parameters through the typed local runner, but the conductor supplies them from the owner's recorded approval. Standing authority never expands the matrix, provider, egress or hard stop.

artifacts: hash-bound 16-cell plan, completed preparation manifest and approval receipt
per-cell prompts, attempt receipts, frozen-source clone receipts, logs, snapshots, check/build/browser reports, file deltas and account deltas
verification: The v3 fixture validator, Hermes query-file preflight, Claude JSON-argument/auth preflight and hidden-process early-exit probe pass; the approval receipt is emitted only after 8 initial roots and prompts validate; dry-run has remoteCallsMade=0; all child processes are hidden; calls are serial; each repair clone matches its frozen source hash before model contact; paid or ambiguous cells are never retried; cumulative terminal-cell deltas stay under the original hard stop; and every buildable cell receives headless browser evidence.
failure_modes: approval receipt emitted before every initial workspace is prepared
repair clone differs from its frozen source or is reused by two repair cells
missing or incorrect target node_modules junction
large prompt placed on the Windows process command line
research-only Fable packet contradicts coding edits
Claude child flags rebound as PowerShell launcher parameters
Claude budget mistaken for provider billing
ClaudeSeek iteration count mistaken for Hermes turn parity
raw BMO page leaked into context
safety_notes: Do not close or restart user-owned terminals or agent sessions.
Hermes coding cells disable the research-only Soul/Fable packet and use the same visible reasoning kernel as ClaudeSeek.
Hermes receives the assembled packet through a retained SHA-256-bound UTF-8 query file.
Plan and dry-run verify all eight initial targets. Repair roots are created lazily from ownership-bound frozen snapshots.
The conductor retains approved plan credentials internally; do not ask the owner to copy and paste them again.
A provider-free retry requires zero balance delta, zero stream, unchanged target and an archived failed attempt.
ContinueAfterFailedCell skips a preserved result and never retries it.
Raw DOM, credentials and unrelated local files never enter delegate context.
